net.wzmn.games.brokencalc.body:
Help "Calci" the calculator to solve math problems without his broken keys!

The goal of the game is to reach a certain number or solve a math problem with a limited set of numbers and some available operations in as few steps as possible - the calculations are made using a calculator that has some broken keys.

The Broken Calculator is an educational game that aims to improve children’s math skills and “number sense” while having fun!.

STUDENTS, PARENTS, TEACHERS can all have fun, play and improve their math skills with Broken Calculator.

PLAY mode – solve EASY, MEDIUM or HARD problems that Broken Calculator presents.

PRACTICE mode – choose the type of problem to work on as well as difficulty level.

CUSTOM mode – choose the keys you wish to disable & the goal you wish to reach – challenge yourself, your friends or your kids.

Tip: Search the Market and try Broken Calculator – Free Trial, version before you buy this full version.
